name: @kolu/acp-harness
//exports: ONE door. Everything this package owns is reachable through `startHarness` and the row/state types the contract already declares in `@kolu/padi-client/orchestrator`; a second subpath would be a second way to reach a subprocess, and there is exactly one subprocess.
//dependencies: THE ONE PACKAGE IN THIS TREE THAT RUNS THE PROTOCOL, so the SDK is a RUNTIME dependency here and a type-only one in `@kolu/acp` (`packages/acp/src/manifest.test.ts` holds both halves). `@kolu/padi-client` is imported for the row and state TYPES alone — the harness writes padi's contract and never reaches for padi itself.
